'''Neb Nagguth''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] child who lived in [[Oluna Biqua]] on [[Genarius]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Neb was the son of [[Syun Nagguth]], a parade pilot. When the gas [[Trinex-M]] was released into the atmosphere of [[Oluna Biqua]], Neb was infected by it, along with the rest of the [[City/Legends|city's]] population. It drove him insane and he stole his father's [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] and began flying it, believing that he was participating in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. The Headhunter was loaded with [[Fireworks/Legends|fireworks]], for an upcoming festival, and Neb fired them at imaginary [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]].
